author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hello, fellow forum user!

I'm getting quite into CTH, so I thought I'd contribute to involving a bit more strategy into it.

The highlights of the kit will include an infinitely long speed I potion effect when you spawn and a drinkable, 90-second speed II potion.

Of course, someone could view this as being a bit OP for CTH because of how the game relies mostly on time. So, to counter this, I gave the kit a gold sword instead of the generic, stone one and gave it the armor of a diamond helmet and iron boots to have one less armor point than regular, full-leather kits and to be able to be identified more easily, ending up looking like this.  

I'm not sure if I'm making it too weak or not.. I'm sure that if it is, changing the sword to be stone would fix the problem. 

Thoughts? :o

Great try on balancing man, I really appreciate it :D

I'd suggest buffing it up some though. Make it have chain leggings and a diamond helm. Also, speed should come with the kit since it is Sonic :)

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: Hmm it may be a little bit weak due to the fact that the speed 2 only lasts for 1:30. If you survive longer than that, you lose your advantage. I would like to see some more feedback on this though.
replies.body_tagged: Hmm it may be a little bit weak due to the fact that the speed 2 only lasts for 1:30. If you survive longer than that, you lose your advantage. I would like to see some more feedback on this though.

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
Yeah, man, but it looks like I've tipped the scales a little too far x3
Your idea of armor is great, but I'm a little concerned about speed II coming as a potion effect with the kit. On a lot of the maps, if someone killed you just over 5 seconds before the hill gets captured, you could most likely get back there in time to capture it, making them killing you not worth it and giving the kit a bit too much power. So, I thought a drinkable potion would be good way to go, and using kycrafft's advise, I'd suggest it to be 8 minutes instead of 1.5. Good idea, though :3

replies.body: I like the idea, but it seems that the effects are a little bit short. Is there any possibility of giving 2 speed II potions to total 3 minutes? I know that seems short, too, but to survive 3 minutes in CTH is a little bit difficult to me. Also, don't call it "Sanic." I get the reference, but i think just calling it "Sonic" would give it more appeal.
